title: 사이버 인문콘텐츠의 수준향상 방안에 관한 연구

abstracts.value: 본 연구는 정보화시대에 학습자료 뿐 아니라 우리 인문학 연구와 발전에 기여할 사이버 인문학 콘텐츠의 개발을 활성화시키고 보다 질 좋은 콘텐츠를 양산할 수 있는 방안을 제시하는 데 목적이 있다. 이를 위해서 국내외의 우수한 웹사이트를 선정하여 운영 및 관리체제, 서비스 내용, 이용실태 등에 관한 사례분석을 실시하였으며, 설문조사를 통하여 사이버공간 인문콘텐츠에 관한 이용실태와 사용자들의 인식과 의견을 분석하였다. 콘텐츠 소비자들은 인문 정보를 인터넷에서 제일 먼저 얻고 있으며, 연구나 직무상의 필요에 의해 인터넷을 주로 검색하는 것으로 나타났다. 콘텐츠의 여러 유형 중 문자(텍스트)를 가장 많이 이용했고 국내 사이버 인문 콘텐츠 내용의 신뢰성과 충실성에 대한 불만은 높지 않았지만, 다양성과 최신성에 대해서는 부정적이었다. 인문콘텐츠 및 정보관련 전문가들에게도 의견을 수렴하여 수준을 향상시키기 위한 정부차원과 학계 및 대학차원의 정책적 방안을 제시하였다.

The purpose of this study is to provide suggestions that would help develop humanities contents on the Internet that support research and development of humanities study as well as teaching materials in the information age. For the purpose, model websites throughout the world were selected to case study maintenance, services provided, usage, and significance. Surveys were also conducted to identify the Internet usage, attitudes, and opinions of people. Furthermore, interviews and meetings were conducted to collect expert views on the Internet contents development. Suggestions for enhancing humanities contents on the Web are offered in terms of governmental and academic aspects. The following were found from the study: First, the majority of people first resorted to the Internet search for the information, primary reason being research and job purposes. Text were preferred most. Half of the respondents relied only upon domestic resources. The biggest unsatisfactory reason for the domestic contents was diversity. Up-to-dateness and inconvenience of locating information were considered next areas to be improved. Negative responses towards domestic contents were stronger among college students and experts. Second, websites in personal, business, national, organizational areas were selected as model cases. The owners of personal websites were either equipped with web development skills, or had access to get such help. Model websites were developed in order to contribute to the advancement of academic field as well as educational materials for school learning. There were government supported websites which were considered superb; partnership with other organizations enhanced quality of the websites. Quality humanities websites were characterized by active participation of humanities experts. Humanities scholars were involved in quality control such as development, classification, evaluation of the websites. Third, in order to enhance the quality of humanities on the web, Korean government, academic field, universities, schools, regular citizens should understand the importance of developing humanities contents on the web and cooperate with each other. The government should provide with comprehensive plan and support the web development. Above all, primary humanities community, scholar group, should recognize the significance and change position from the consumers of the web contents to the creators of them. Fourth, the evaluation of the websites should be conducted regularly.
